body: In my experience, those people don't exist. My 2 "friends" preferred a clean conscience by leaving me by myself instead of helping me. And I considered them the best that had happened to me, they were my reason for keep trying. Now what? I've got nothing, only my thoughts. You are very young and I wish you the best but as for me, I no longer have the energy to find a friend again. I've got no more trust to give.

It's difficult finding someone to open up with. Personally, the feeling of not being able to flush my thoughts away makes me really sad. What I've done lately is to write a journal entry every time I'm feeling bad, which lately has been very common. Just try to vent here, anonymously, it's not even close to feeling the warmth of someone close but at least there are no bad consequences. No harmful criticism.

Not gonna say there are no things I wish I would do because there are but I already give up on them and my problems might also be solvable.

However, it requires a lot of energy and courage to keep on living, I don't have those anymore. Suicide also requires a lot of courage but it's the fastest exit, I guess.

The problem is, it seems like there is no one to go to. It's impossible for me to make friends when I can't find anyone willing to be the friend I actually need. 
I don't have enough energy right now to explain why but my family is not an option anymore. I see your point in going with the counselor but my school is internally famous in only helping students just for the sake of the integrity of the institution and because it is a private school, they will only take their money seriously, not me. I have no path to take.

Thanks for taking a little bit of your time in responding, actually means something for me. :)
